character.locked_description: Zayan is a 9-year-old South Asian boy with a lean build and warm brown skin. He has a round face framed by tight, dark curls. He wears a bright red-orange hoodie, color #E4572E, featuring a noticeably frayed left cuff, paired with dark slate blue pants, color #2E4057. On his feet are scuffed white trainers. A thick blue rubber band rests around his left wrist as a sensory grounding tool. At rest, his posture is asymmetrical, captured mid-motion with his weight shifted forward and his feet positioned as if tapping a rapid rhythm.
